_comment: Golden points for validate_grid.py (plan section 8). Airport points sit on the extended runway centreline (cross-track error recorded in 'basis'), not on outcode centroids, which fall between glidepaths. Postcode coordinates are from postcodes.io (ONS Postcode Directory); where no postcode centroid lay within 100 m of the centreline the ideal centreline point is used and 'postcode' is null. Expectation keys: top1_airport, top1_op, top1_runway (string or list), oh_day_mean_min/max, oh_alt_p50_ft [lo, hi] (feet AMSL), days_active_frac [lo, hi] (oh_days_active / days_observed), coverage_in (allowed res-7 status; a missing coverage row counts as insufficient), no_airport_attribution (top1_airport must be null or the cell absent), not_good_unless_floor_le (a 'good' cell must have floor_ft at or below this). Points under the minor-wind end of a runway (Bristol 09, Cardiff 12) only assert the airport and A or D: the opposite end's departures share that ground track, so the top operation flips with the prevailing wind. top1_op and top1_runway accept a string or a list., cell_may_be_absent. Thresholds are provisional until the pilot month has run; widen or tighten them from that output, never from a single day. 'centreline' names the runway end whose extended centreline the point sits on; tests/test_validate_grid.py checks the geometry against the reference data.
